root_cause: The 1000 microsecond pulseIn timeout cannot capture echoes beyond roughly 17 cm.
fix: Use a timeout around 30000 microseconds for the sensor 400 cm range.
how_to_see_it: Start at 100 cm, then set 5 cm; only the short distance produces a reading.

root_cause: The ON interval uses delayMicroseconds(1000), lasting 1 ms instead of the intended 1000 ms.
how_to_see_it: Watch the LED for five seconds; brief 1 ms pulses are separated by one second.

root_cause: lcd.clear immediately erases each newly printed count before the one-second display interval.
fix: Move lcd.clear before setCursor and print.
how_to_see_it: Run for several seconds and watch the backlit screen; text is immediately erased.

root_cause: On Uno, Servo takes Timer1, which disables normal analogWrite PWM on pins 9 and 10.
fix: Move the LED to a PWM pin on another timer, such as D5, and update analogWrite and pinMode.
how_to_see_it: Start simulation; compare the indicator behavior after moving its PWM output to D5.

root_cause: The DHT library is configured for the DHT11 protocol and byte layout while the connected device is a DHT22.
fix: Change the constructor sensor type from DHT11 to DHT22.
how_to_see_it: Run for at least five seconds with sliders at 24 C and 40 percent; compare the serial values.

root_cause: Uno D4 has no hardware PWM; analogWrite falls back to a binary LOW/HIGH output.
fix: Move the LED output wire and both code references to PWM-capable D3, D5, D6, D9, D10, or D11.
how_to_see_it: Observe a full five-second ramp; the LED jumps at the midpoint instead of fading.

root_cause: ESP32 analogRead defaults to 12-bit values up to 4095, but the sketch scales with Uno 10-bit full scale 1023.
fix: Divide by 4095.0, or explicitly select analogReadResolution(10) before retaining the 1023 divisor.
how_to_see_it: Rotate the knob from minimum to maximum; reported percentage rises to roughly 400.

root_cause: MPU6050 AD0 is tied HIGH, selecting I2C address 0x69, while the code communicates with 0x68.
fix: Set imuAddress to 0x69, or connect AD0 to ground to use 0x68.
how_to_see_it: Run and observe repeated not-found messages; the WHO_AM_I register remains 0x68 even at bus address 0x69.

root_cause: The Wokwi buzzer is a passive piezo; a constant HIGH voltage cannot create a sustained tone.
fix: Use tone(8, 1000) to generate an alternating signal.
how_to_see_it: Enable simulator audio and run; there is no sustained tone despite the HIGH output.

root_cause: Uno attachInterrupt external interrupts are supported only on D2 and D3; D4 maps to NOT_AN_INTERRUPT.
fix: Move the button signal to D2 or D3 and update pinMode and digitalPinToInterrupt accordingly.
how_to_see_it: Press and release the button repeatedly; the serial counter remains zero with bouncing disabled.
